source_caption_data.pre_caption: The video begins with a medium shot centered on a group of people. A woman in an orange jacket is in the foreground-center, holding a clapperboard. To her left and slightly behind in the middle ground are a woman in a red vest and a man in a striped shirt. A man in a white tank top stands in the right middle ground, with two other men positioned in the background. The woman in orange claps the board and moves it down and out of the frame as the shot transitions to a full shot. Simultaneously, a man in a black leather jacket enters from the left foreground, and a man in a yellow cardigan enters from the right foreground, moving toward the center. The final composition shows the full group standing in a loose circle in the middle ground, illuminated by a central spotlight on a wooden floor, as they begin to interact and embrace. The camera is positioned at the subjects' level throughout.
